question: How is the meditated figure positioned in relation to the moon?
premises: One meditates on a figure seated on a moon-seat.
The figure is struck from above by the moon.
This describes a specific visual arrangement.
inference: The practitioner should visualize the figure seated on a moon-seat and touched by the moon above.
plain_english: Having meditated on him seated on a moon-seat and struck from above by the moon...
